# Binary & Format Recon Lead

## Core idea
Unfamiliar or damaged payloads deserve mechanical recon before storytelling: identify format, extract readable strings, observe behavior with controlled inputs—then commit to a path.

## Practice
- Start with cheap universal probes before deep inference.
- Prefer standard recovery tools for the format when they exist.
- When transformation is unknown, use structural anchors (magic bytes, headers, repeats) before guessing ciphers.

## Anti-patterns
Announcing format from extension alone; abandoning ship without emitting the best partial structurally valid output the spec allows.
